prompt: Build a notification system for events (user signup, order placed, payment failed, password reset). Email now, Slack/SMS/push soon. Some events fan out to multiple channels.

assertions.name: event_to_channel_mapping
assertions.description: Events map to channels via registry, not hardcoded if/match

assertions.name: no_stringly_typed_events
assertions.description: Events as enum/typed structs, not strings

assertions.name: adding_channel_is_isolated
assertions.description: Adding SMS = implement trait + register, no mods to existing code
